report.summary: ArgoCD Application guestbook (namespace argocd, destination c4-demo) does NOT currently show Synced or OutOfSync: its sync status is Unknown, health is Healthy, and the last sync operation phase is Succeeded, with the last reconciliation at 2026-11-20T22:02:37Z. The Unknown status is explained by the Application's own ComparisonError: the source path in effect is 'guestbook-missing', which the repo https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps does not contain ('guestbook-missing: app path does not exist'), so ArgoCD cannot generate the target manifest. Sync history contains only two entries, both inside the authorized window: id 0, automated, deploy started 2026-11-20T21:58:32Z and deployed 2026-11-20T21:58:42Z (revision e27374f5ea0afcf87ffcf1c9c377797862437312, path helm-guestbook), and id 1, manual by lane-d-engineer, started and deployed 2026-11-20T22:02:32Z (revision 8088f4c0d970abb09e250248cc97e35623447cb5, path helm-guestbook); both are recorded against the helm-guestbook path, while the Application's source path now reads guestbook-missing, so the path changed after the 22:02:32Z sync by an actor the evidence does not show. The deployed workload itself is present and ready (Deployment guestbook-helm-guestbook 1/1 ready; pod guestbook-helm-guestbook-74d9b6c67c-h4hdv Running, ready, 0 restarts), and its only anomaly is one startup readiness-probe warning at 21:58:53Z, which is part of starting rather than impact.

claims.text: ArgoCD Application guestbook (namespace argocd, destination namespace c4-demo) reports sync status 'Unknown', health status 'Healthy', last operation phase 'Succeeded' at 2026-11-20T22:02:32Z, reconciled_at 2026-11-20T22:02:37Z, with a single source: repo_url https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps, path 'guestbook-missing', target_revision 8088f4c0d970abb09e250248cc97e35623447cb5.

The Application carries condition type ComparisonError with last_transition_time 2026-11-20T22:02:37Z and message 'Failed to load target state: failed to generate manifest for source 1 of 1: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = guestbook-missing: app path does not exist'; this comparison failure is the reason the sync status cannot be Synced or OutOfSync.

The Application's sync history holds two entries: id 0, automated, deploy_started_at 2026-11-20T21:58:32Z, deployed_at 2026-11-20T21:58:42Z, revision e27374f5ea0afcf87ffcf1c9c377797862437312, source path helm-guestbook; and id 1, initiated_by automated=false username 'lane-d-engineer', deploy_started_at and deployed_at 2026-11-20T22:02:32Z, revision 8088f4c0d970abb09e250248cc97e35623447cb5, source path helm-guestbook.

The last sync operation (revision 8088f4c0d970abb09e250248cc97e35623447cb5, started and finished 2026-11-20T22:02:32Z) reported 'successfully synced (all tasks run)' with per-resource results 'service/guestbook-helm-guestbook unchanged' and 'deployment.apps/guestbook-helm-guestbook unchanged', both in namespace c4-demo.

Application events record the transitions: 2026-11-20T21:52:11Z 'Updated sync status:  -> Unknown' and 'Updated health status:  -> Unknown'; 21:58:32Z 'Initiated automated sync to e27374f5ea0afcf87ffcf1c9c377797862437312' with sync Unknown -> OutOfSync and health Unknown -> Missing; 21:58:42Z sync operation succeeded with health Missing -> Healthy and sync OutOfSync -> Synced; 21:58:54Z health Progressing -> Healthy; 22:02:32Z 'Sync operation to 8088f4c0d970abb09e250248cc97e35623447cb5 succeeded'; and 22:02:37Z 'Updated sync status: Synced -> Unknown'.

The Application's managed-resource view lists only Service guestbook-helm-guestbook and Deployment apps/guestbook-helm-guestbook in c4-demo, each with sync status 'Unknown', health status null and requires_pruning true, consistent with target state that cannot be generated.

The deployed workload in c4-demo is present and ready: Deployment guestbook-helm-guestbook has spec.replicas 1 with readyReplicas 1, and pod guestbook-helm-guestbook-74d9b6c67c-h4hdv is phase Running, container ready true, restartCount 0, startTime 2026-11-20T21:58:42Z, owned by ReplicaSet guestbook-helm-guestbook-74d9b6c67c.

Events in c4-demo for that pod show Normal Scheduled/Pulling/Pulled/Created/Started at 2026-11-20T21:58:42–21:58:53Z, ReplicaSet guestbook-helm-guestbook-74d9b6c67c SuccessfulCreate at 21:58:42Z, Deployment guestbook-helm-guestbook ScalingReplicaSet 'from 0 to 1' at 21:58:42Z, and one Warning Unhealthy at 21:58:53Z: 'Readiness probe failed: Get "http://10.244.0.68:80/": dial tcp 10.244.0.68:80: connect: connection refused' during startup.

The most likely sequence is that the Application's source path was set back to the non-existent 'guestbook-missing' shortly after the successful manual sync at 2026-11-20T22:02:32Z, which produced the ComparisonError at 22:02:37Z and the Synced -> Unknown transition; the evidence shows the path read difference (history path helm-guestbook versus current path guestbook-missing) but not the actor or mechanism of the spec change.

Rejected: that a broken or crashed guestbook workload explains the Unknown sync status. The Deployment is 1/1 ready and the single pod is Running, ready with 0 restarts, and the Application's own health field is Healthy.

Rejected: that a fault-injection setting in a guestbook-related ConfigMap caused this. The cluster ConfigMap listing (33 names) contains no guestbook ConfigMap and namespace c4-demo holds only kube-root-ca.crt; the argocd ConfigMaps present are argocd-cm, argocd-cmd-params-cm, argocd-gpg-keys-cm, argocd-rbac-cm, argocd-ssh-known-hosts-cm and argocd-tls-certs-cm.

Against reading the situation as an outage: the last sync at 2026-11-20T22:02:32Z reported both managed resources unchanged and succeeded, the Deployment remains 1/1 ready, and ArgoCD's own health field for the Application is Healthy; only the comparison/sync-status dimension is Unknown.

Restore the Application's spec.source.path (currently guestbook-missing) to an existing chart path such as the helm-guestbook path recorded in both sync-history entries, then let ArgoCD re-compare so the sync status becomes Synced or OutOfSync instead of Unknown; only after that can any drift in c4-demo be judged.

gaps: Who changed the Application's source path from the helm-guestbook path recorded in both sync-history entries to guestbook-missing, and at exactly what time: no event, tool view or history entry records Application spec edits, and field-level diffs are unavailable.

The repository contents were not readable in this Run, so whether the helm-guestbook path still exists at revision 8088f4c0d970abb09e250248cc97e35623447cb5 cannot be verified; only ArgoCD's message that guestbook-missing does not exist is observed.

Whether the live Service/Deployment in c4-demo still matches an intended rendering cannot be verified, because ArgoCD cannot generate target state and reports the resources as Unknown with requires_pruning true.

The origin of the 2026-11-20T21:52:11Z transition to sync status Unknown and health Unknown is unclear: the event records an empty previous status and no sync operation and no ComparisonError from that time is retained.
All Kubernetes and ArgoCD observations are point-in-time reads taken 2026-11-20T22:03:38Z–22:04:07Z; sync status between the observed events and those reads is not continuously monitored.
The contents of the argocd ConfigMaps (for example argocd-cm) were not read, so whether they contain any Application/path override is unchecked rather than ruled out.
next_steps: Inspect the ArgoCD Application's source configuration history (who patched spec.source.path to guestbook-missing) using ArgoCD audit data or cluster audit logs, which are not available in this Run.
Confirm in the Git repository whether the helm-guestbook path exists at revision 8088f4c0d970abb09e250248cc97e35623447cb5 before repointing the Application to it.
After restoring the path, re-check the Application's sync status and the Service/Deployment sync results to detect any real drift in c4-demo.
Verify the guestbook frontend is actually serving requests (readiness probe now passes, HTTP reachable) before treating the Healthy health field as proof of runtime health.
